camera.sensitivityHelp: Left: fewer frames count as failures (far left, almost none). Right: more frames count as failures (far right, almost all).
camera.voteHelp: A defect is raised when at least the threshold number of the last window frames show a failure, so the window is never smaller than the threshold.

printer.title: Printer
printer.help: Works with an SBC on this computer (plugin), or a Duet in SBC mode or standalone on the network - which one is found when connecting.

actions.title: Printer Actions
actions.help: Commands sent to the printer when a defect is detected and nobody intervenes. Leave blank to use the default.

pushover.title: Pushover Alert
pushover.help: Both the API token and user key are required to send Pushover alerts.

IP.label: Printer Address
IP.hint: IP address or name of the printer. Leave blank only if this computer is the printer's SBC. Not used when running as a DWC plugin.

PASSWORD.label: Printer Password
PASSWORD.hint: Only if a password is set on the printer.

IP.label: IP Address
IP.hint: IP address of this machine, detected automatically at startup.

PORT.label: Port
PORT.hint: Port for the Detection, Settings and Configuration pages. Must not conflict with DWC or other plugins. Use 0 to pick a free port automatically at startup. If the chosen port is in use, a free port is picked instead.

OPENBROWSER.label: Open Browser at Startup
OPENBROWSER.hint: Open these pages in this computer's browser when duetPrintGuard starts. Not used when running as a DWC plugin, or without a desktop.

MACRO.label: Macro
MACRO.hint: Macro called on failure e.g. to send MQTT. Enter just the path used in M98 P"<path>".

TOPIC.label: Topic
TOPIC.hint: The ntfy topic you subscribe to. Required to send ntfy alerts.

config.systemDefaultHint: Leave blank to use the system text shown, which follows the camera and countdown settings.
config.footerAfter: take effect after duetPrintGuard is restarted. Other settings apply immediately. Each Save button saves the settings on all the tabs.

config.savedRestartShort: Saved - restart duetPrintGuard for some changes to take effect.
config.invalid: Some settings are invalid - nothing was saved.
config.invalidShort: Some settings are invalid (marked in red) - nothing was saved.
